purpose: conditional predictive-value audit after the A4 non-redundancy gate did not stop

a4_gate_outcome.note: J_latent_D0 ProbeFit R2 is dominated by one extreme ProbeFit molecule; AuditEval R2 is 0.774. The gate is false in all cases (threshold 0.98).

ssl.scope: Fit8k rows only (row list frozen in configs/split_fit8k_probe_audit.json)
ssl.mechanism: bjoc_masked_pretraining_v1: 15% atoms + 15% physical bonds, full masked-object rebuild, CE+CE 1/1
ssl.note: Same budget as the historical full-10k masked SSL; restricting the row set makes the initialization strictly Fit8k-inductive.

dccl_reference.last_epoch_partial: 24 batches after 752 complete epochs of 63 batches
dccl_reference.selection: none; official valid, ProbeFit and AuditEval are never evaluated for selection
dccl_reference.normalization: global33 mean/scale from Fit8k rows only; root/block scalar fields are not consumed by the DCC-L P3N collate
dccl_reference.ssl_pairing: supervised seed 0 <- SSL seed 0; seed 1 <- SSL seed 1

ridge.standardization: X and residual target means/scales from ProbeFit only

audit_heads.ZN: z + J_hat_raw (32) + J_hat_latent (4), J_hat fitted on Fit8k only with the same ridge grid/CV

j_hat.features: full z from the corresponding frozen backbone

huber_sensitivity.fit: same ProbeFit rows, standardized inputs/target; one fixed setting, no tuning

audit_heads.prediction_freeze: AuditEval predictions and their SHA256 are written and hashed before any AuditEval label is indexed

bootstrap.interpretation: fixed-model sample uncertainty only; not training-seed uncertainty

support_strata.definition: radius-2 typed atom-environment hash (WL-style 2-iteration subtree hash over atom types and bond types)
support_strata.molecule_assignment: unseen if any atom environment has 0 Fit8k molecules; else low_support if any has 1-4; else full_support
support_strata.atom_counts: number of independent Fit8k molecules containing each environment, not atom occurrences

decision_rules.A: A4 nonredundant AND Gain_J > 0 on both supervised seeds AND Gain_vs_N > 0 on both seeds AND Gain_J >= 0.003 MAE AND paired 95% interval excludes 0 on both seeds AND best-10-worst-row removal does not reverse the sign
decision_rules.B: A4 nonredundant but the label-gain criteria are not met
decision_rules.C: A4 gate STOP (all candidate blocks R2 >= 0.98 and residual share <= 0.02)
decision_rules.D: ZJ improves over Z but Z or ZN captures the same gain; no independent joint-statistic benefit
decision_rules.E: seeds/intervals/strata/health insufficient for a stable classification
decision_rules.tag_rule: diagnostic tags never override the main class
